cases.question: Held current body reuse control
cases.prompt:
Explain the size-limit units and equality behavior from this current code already available in the conversation.

```ruby
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Export::ValidateDocuments
def unsupported_file(document, terms)
    extension = document.file_extension.to_s.downcase
    limit = terms.max_file_size_mb.megabytes

    return :unsupported_file_format unless terms.accepted_file_formats.include?(extension)

    :file_too_large if document.file_size > limit
  end
```
